findings.title: Later final make verify failed before the completion-cancellation fixture established child readiness or workload admission; owned cleanup proof is incomplete
findings.actual: The unchanged3-second parent context expires. Retained native result has zero attempts, empty history/journals, no child readiness address or entropy protocol, all six raw child streams empty, three Waited=true/exit1 process records, SocketClosed=false and cleanup_complete=false. Final make verify is a completedFAIL170.109s/exit2, with this sole named test failure.
findings.classification: Actual final verification and the AC019 cancellation/cleanup assertion fail. The raw evidence is a startup/readiness interruption, not an observed blocked-completion wait: never-ack and blocked actions were never invoked. INCONCLUSIVE is the correct semantic status; current evidence does not establish a leaked live child or reachable socket, nor does it establish complete cleanup.
causal_source_inspection: Run starts all three children, then waits for actual protocol readiness under the caller context and separate5-second readiness timer. The test's3-second context can end this phase before workload admission.

stop re-reads bounded retained stdout after owned Kill/Wait. When no ready address exists, its fixed-address TCP check is not performed and SocketClosed remains false, producing the observed closure-not-established error.

cleanup unconditionally hashes all three node journals. Here the journals do not exist; fileHash calls regularPath(path,false), whose Lstat missing-file path returns ErrUnsafePath. The generic ownership message therefore does not by itself show an alias, permission violation or malicious path.

The same-test-binary TestMain measures the complete source via buildinfo.FromFiles before dispatching lab-node. The later installed evidence enlarges the source set while retaining the146 execution inputs. Extra startup work is a hypothesis consistent with the empty pre-readiness streams; the preserved artifact contains no timing sample establishing a sole source-scan, OS scheduling or security-software cause.
findings.required_next: Preserve actual failed command/fixture/source/assertions/deadlines and diagnose startup/cancellation admission with concrete independently reviewed changes or controls. Do not assign successful cleanup without proof, weaken owned-path/socket/journal guards, inflate deadlines, skip/select away assertions, blindly retry to green or retag the earlier all24 judgment. Fresh affected and final/full verification is required after a compatible repair.
